rule.description: A local type whose inherent methods form three or more mutually disconnected responsibility clusters while exposing at least ten methods centralizes unrelated responsibilities: methods group by shared type state or mutual calls, and every cluster that shares no state and calls none of the other clusters belongs with a component of its own, not with this one type.

checks.description: Detects a local type that concentrates several unrelated responsibilities: its inherent methods split into three or more disconnected clusters (clusters connect only through shared fields of the type or mutual method calls) while the type exposes at least ten methods.
checks.detected_relation: central owner QuickCheck <- absorbed responsibilities (environment configuration, logging bootstrap, outcome construction, panic interception, failure formatting, vector shrinking) that share none of the owner's state and call none of each other
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Each disconnected method family on the one central type is a distinct responsibility that belongs with the component that owns it (configuration logic, the outcome type, the reporting machinery, the shrinker type); their presence all on the runner violates single responsibility and makes the central type the mandatory edit site for every concern.

matches.evidence: QuickCheck exposes 24 inherent methods across two impl blocks (src/tester.rs and src/arbitrary.rs) that partition into 17 disconnected responsibility clusters: the run-driving core (new, rng, gen, tests, max_tests, min_tests_passed, quicktest, quickcheck) shares the configured run state, while default_tests, default_max_tests, default_gen_size, default_min_tests_passed (environment configuration), init_logging (logging bootstrap), result_from_bool, result_passed, result_failed, result_error, result_discard, result_must_fail (outcome construction), safe_run (panic interception), debug_reprs (failure formatting), and new_vec_shrinker, vec_shrinker_next, vec_shrinker_next_element (vector shrinking) each share no state of the type and call none of the other families.

excluded.reason: The outcome type retains 9 inherent methods (below the rule's ten-method threshold) and, although its constructors now delegate to the absorbed runner helpers, it does not itself match the rule.
The generator type has 6 inherent methods, all operating on its own rng/size state (a single cohesive cluster); below both thresholds.
After absorption the shrinker keeps no inherent impl of its own; only its trait impl remains, and the rule counts inherent methods only.
The procedural-macro crate contains no runtime types with inherent impls, so the rule has no owner to measure there.
